name: Technical Debt Reckoning
axiom: Shortcuts accrue interest quietly until the system cannot absorb its own change.
trigger: Refactoring proposals and engineering re-allocation, where velocity has slowed and no one agrees why.

steps.text: Accrued shortcuts: the decisions that bought speed.
Drag: the recurring cost each one now adds.
Seizure: the change the system can no longer absorb.
Blueprint: the refactor sequence and what it unblocks.

antiPattern.violation: Calling all code you did not write debt, which turns a specific argument about interest into a taste dispute.
antiPattern.remediation: Price the interest: name the change that is now slow or impossible, and how often it comes up.
